newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan end-Sept kerosene stocks up 8.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan end-Sept kerosene stocks up 8.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's kerosene stockpiles as of end-September were 4.8 million kilolitres (kl), up 8.7 percent from a year earlier and up 13.8 percent compared to a month earlier, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Friday.
Refiners have been keeping oil product stockpiles at low levels in order to cut storage costs.
However, they need to build stocks of kerosene, used for heating, as the winter months approach.
MITI expects kerosene demand in the October to March period to fall to 21.88 million kl, down 2.3 percent from the same period a year earlier.
